source.pageNumbering: PDF page (1-based). `printedPage` is the number printed on the leaf.
source.image: RENDERED LOCALLY from data/.r2_cache/justin_martyr_apologies_clean.pdf via PyMuPDF at 300 DPI (= the scan's native resolution), WebP q82. The local PDF is byte-size identical to the production R2 object (111,244,749 B). Nothing uploaded.
source.ocrText: PRODUCTION. `text` field of page_NNNN.json inside the R2 object `justin_martyr_apologies_clean.ocr.zip` (uploaded 2026-08-01T00:46:32Z), i.e. exactly what `GET /books/{bookId}/pages/{n}/ocr` returns after `ensure_text_local`.
source.cleanText: PRODUCTION. `text_clean or text` of page_NNNN.json inside the R2 object `justin_martyr_apologies_clean.clean.zip` (uploaded 2026-08-01T00:46:33Z), i.e. exactly what `GET /books/{bookId}/pages/{n}/clean`.textClean returns and what the reader loads (Patristic-AI-Fe src/room/lib/api.ts fetchPageText).
source.displayBody: DERIVED at FE 3add663 (deployed origin/main). Produced by running the committed audit harness scripts/audit-footnotes.ts `classifyPage()` — the repo's own replica of src/room/reader/TextView.tsx routing, over the real src/room/tts/segmentation.ts + src/room/reader/footnotes.ts. NOT a React render.
source.displayFootnotes: DERIVED at FE 3add663. One entry per parsed note rendered as `label + raw` (TextView room-footnotes-list), with the parseFootnotes().bodyText REMAINDER appended last (room-footnotes-remainder). EMPTY whenever `trusted` is false — see failOpen.
source.narrationSpans: DERIVED at BE 1799de2 (deployed origin/main) by src/lib/audiobook/segmentation.py::segment_page(page, cleanText, language), the same call src/lib/audiobook/pipeline.py::plan_spans makes. The span TEXT is not stored in the production book_audio table (only span_id/page/state), so it is DERIVED, not stored; span-id parity against the stored rows is reported per page in `narrationParity`.
